source: Official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT aggregate trades and event-level BBO, 2024-01-15
feature: trailing 60-second correlation between absolute one-second signed taker flow and absolute ten-second rolling signed taker flow
outcome: next-60-second maximum absolute BBO midpoint excursion
sampling: 10-second decisions, contiguous 60/20/20 split, training-only 95th percentile jump threshold
baseline: spread mean/last, depth mean/min, imbalance mean/last, realized volatility, trade volume, signed trade imbalance, event rate
individual_gate: positive Spearman correlation and strictly positive 95% high-minus-low excursion interval over 10-minute test blocks
incremental_model_gate: test average-precision improvement greater than 0.02 and positive Brier improvement
interpretation: This clean independent date can strengthen or reject H30, but the underlying day was previously inspected for other features and is not final trading approval.
